title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures pause rally as Iran claims ceasefire broken in under 24 hours
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货暂停涨势，因伊朗声称停火在 24 小时内被打破
summary: Stock futures paused a historic rally as the tentative ceasefire between the US and Iran was broken.
summary_zh: 由于美国和伊朗之间的临时停火协议被打破，股票期货暂停了历史性上涨。

title: Dow spikes by over 1,300, oil prices retreat in ceasefire rally
title_zh: 道指飙升逾1,300点 油价因停火反弹而回落
summary: All three of the major indexes (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) closed Wednesday's session with colossal gains — the Dow Jones Industrial Average skyrocketed by over 1,320 points (2.85%) and the Nasdaq Composite surged by nearly 620 points (2.8%) — after President Trump announced that Ira...
summary_zh: 在特朗普总统宣布伊拉克...

title: BofA hikes 2026 chips forecast to $1.3 trillion, names Nvidia, Broadcom, Marvell, AMD as top drivers
title_zh: 美国银行将 2026 年芯片预测上调至 1.3 万亿美元，将 Nvidia、Broadcom、Marvell、AMD 列为主要推动者
summary: Bank of America added $300 billion to its revenue target in just four months, doubling down on Nvidia, Broadcom, and AMD as the AI boom accelerates.
summary_zh: 随着人工智能热潮加速，美国银行在短短四个月内将其收入目标增加了 3000 亿美元，对 Nvidia、Broadcom 和 AMD 的投资加倍。

title: Apple stock is the new retail investor darling
summary: Apple catches a whiff of retail investor buying.
summary_zh: 苹果公司嗅到了散户投资者买盘的气息。

title: The many ways consumers are being hit by the Iran war
title_zh: 伊朗战争对消费者造成的打击有多种
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma explains the myriad ways consumers are being impacted by the war in Iran, even amid news of a ceasefire.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级记者布鲁克·迪帕尔玛（Brooke DiPalma）解释了伊朗战争对消费者的多种影响，即使是在停火消息传出的情况下。

title: US-Iran ceasefire sends investors back to their most beloved stocks
title_zh: 美伊停火让投资者重回他们最喜爱的股票
summary: Tech stocks are back in focus.

title: Why Microsoft is a 'screaming buy.'
title_zh: 为什么微软是“尖叫收购”？
summary: Big Tech and AI have been under pressure for months, but is it time to bet big on one familiar name?
summary_zh: 几个月来，大型科技公司和人工智能一直面临压力，但现在是时候在一个熟悉的名字上押下重注了吗？

title: Retail investors are buying the dip in Tesla stock
title_zh: 散户投资者正在买入特斯拉股票的下跌
summary: The bottom fishers come out for Tesla.
summary_zh: 底层渔民为特斯拉出击。

title: Morning Brief: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee 'nervous' about impact of oil shock on economy
title_zh: 早间简报：芝加哥联储古尔斯比对石油冲击对经济的影响感到“紧张”
summary: The stock market, with President Trump's threat to Iran that a "whole civilization will die tonight" at top of mind, still managed to eke out gains as hope remained on Tuesday of a diplomatic resolution.
summary_zh: 股市在特朗普总统威胁伊朗“整个文明今晚将消亡”的情况下，仍设法勉强上涨，因为周二外交解决方案仍抱有希望。
